title: New York City Pedicab Tour of Landmarks And Hidden Gems
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: You’ll be guided by licensed New York City locals who started pedicab tours in NYC. As native and local New Yorkers, we bring an insider’s perspective that only comes from living here. We’ll show you a side of New York most visitors never get to see — the kind of experience only true locals can offer. We don’t just show you landmarks; we share the real stories behind them, including insider history, famous movie locations, and hidden spots only locals know. We tailor each tour to your interests, stop for unforgettable photos, and even include food stops if you’re hungry for a taste of NYC.
